protocol: Deembedded hBN positive SET voltage. Per-trace shape uses only 0.30–0.48 V; current normalization uses hBN 0.5 V. Score separate points at 0.58–1.20 V. Pick common transport parameters on lower-gate training SET return only; split lower-gate scans by workbook row order and hold out 1.4/1.5 V entirely from common fitting. SET return is a presumed fixed-state comparison, not independently verified. SET outward can already include state evolution, so its results are a consistency check rather than fixed-state ground truth. Finite-rate expression is physically motivated, not a microscopic identification.
